_readme: Correspondence between this report's content.md slots and the Pol.is conversation's comment ids (tid), for tax-fairness/scripts/polis-sync-primer.py. Built by fingerprinting each tally.span-N's (agree, total, pass, disagree) tuple against a fresh fetch-polis-report.py pull and disambiguating the handful of ties (two items sharing a tally) against the accompanying idea text. Re-verify by hand if this project's slot keys are ever renamed, or if content.md's ideas are reordered.
not_covered: of.span-1 ('/28', the invited-member count) -- not knowable from Pol.is at all; it only ever sees who voted, never who was invited. Hand-entered, stays hand-entered.

lbl.span-1 ('Members voted · 43%') and turnout.p-1 ('12 of 28 ... 43% turnout') -- the 43% is participant_count/invited, so it's only computable once the 28 above is supplied some other way. Not wired into the sync script; recompute by hand if participant_count or the invited count changes.

The header's other three meta-stat numbers (12, 7, 14) and the '3' disagree-count stat, the turnout bar's 42.9% width, and every per-idea vote bar's own inline width (e.g. style="width:58.3%") -- these are literal text/CSS baked directly into body.slotted.html, not slotted in content.md at all. They currently match this pull (verified by hand against tax-fairness/data/polis/tfc-2027-priorities.json), but this script can't reach them, and won't notice if they ever drift.
